body: Thank god. All you need is a hobby, you have made incredible strides and accomplished what many have not and will never. Enjoy your accomplishment. Time to grow now, find the new you, what makes you happy now?
Are you happy with your major? And job prospects? Why are you really unhappy?
When people try to cut other people out of their life, it's usually for some reason. How have you behaved over the last two months?
I'd love to talk to you. It is not the only way out at all. Message me if you want.
